There is a blue logo/text on the hood and a small blue square sticker on the rear side panel. The background includes a corrugated metal wall and some greenery.

While the door is closed, the vertical seam and handle placement on the side correspond to a standard sliding door mechanism found on minibuses.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, typical for this type of van-based minibus.
